_comment: Single source for every RustSec advisory exception. deny.toml [advisories].ignore and .cargo/audit.toml must match it exactly; packages/release/advisory-exceptions.mjs fails on missing fields, expired reviewBy, scope drift against Cargo.lock, or any mismatch. Renewal needs fresh evidence. Policy: Astra 2026-10-22, D:/scratch/rk-888/astra-advisories-answer.md. unaffectedVersions lists other locked versions of the same crate that the advisory does not cover. dependents is the exact set of Cargo.lock packages that directly depend on an affected version; the gate fails if a consumer is added or removed, and every hop of path must be a Cargo.lock dependency edge.

exceptions.rationale: Marvin timing attack applies to RSA private-key operations; rightkit-ownership only parses and exports public keys and verifies signatures, and no RustCrypto RSA private-key operation exists in the workspace.
exceptions.approvedBy: Astra 2026-10-22, D:/scratch/rk-888/astra-advisories-answer.md; rightkit-ownership 0.4.0 re-checked by RK Fable 2026-10-22: rsa use unchanged (crates/rightkit-ownership/src/keylog.rs public-key parse, size/exponent check and PSS/PKCS1v15 verify only; no private-key operation in the crate); rightkit-ownership 0.4.1 re-checked by RightKit Mac new 2026-10-23: keylog.rs unchanged since 0.4.0 (git diff f893f78d..208dc78f empty for it); 0.4.1 only moves catalog-digest drift to a warning (approval.rs/verdict.rs/evidence.rs/admission.rs), no rsa use added; rsa use remains public-key parse, size/exponent check and PSS/PKCS1v15 verify; rightkit-ownership 0.4.2 re-checked by RightKit Mac new 2026-10-23: catalog JSON entry only (right-suite-api capability), no src change, no rsa use added

exceptions.rationale: Scope is the mitex DEFAULT_SPEC path only: the typeset wrapper passes None, so mitex deserializes its embedded include_bytes data and user LaTeX never becomes archive bytes.
glib arrives only through tauri's Linux/BSD-gated GTK dependency; RightKit release targets are Windows and macOS only. Invalidated the moment any GTK (Linux or BSD) target ships.
exceptions.evidence: tauri-2.11.5/Cargo.toml:335 (Linux/BSD-gated gtk); .github/workflows/publish.yml:603 (release build matrix is xcode-27 and windows-2025 only); ci/linux-required.json (Linux verify row for @rightkit/qa-chrome only, crates empty)

exceptions.rationale: ttf-parser is unmaintained (a maintenance notice, no vulnerability). It is a direct dependency of rightkit-pdf and also arrives through the typst and font stack (fontdb, lopdf, pixglyph, rustybuzz, typst-layout, typst-library, typst-render, typst-svg, usvg); the dependents set is pinned. Migration to skrifa is tracked in rightkit#890.

tauri-plugin-updater 2.10.1 requires zip ^4 as an optional Windows-only dependency (2.14.0, the latest, still does); rightkit-tauri-shell installs only bytes returned by the plugin's minisign-verified download, identity-rechecked before install, so no unsigned archive is ever extracted.
exceptions.evidence: tauri-plugin-updater-2.10.1/src/updater.rs:652-712 download() verifies the minisign signature before returning bytes; install(bytes) at :718 does not, so crates/rightkit-tauri-shell/src/update/tauri_transport.rs:214-229 installs only the VerifiedBytes token produced by download_verified (:231-245) after an identity recheck; 2.14.0 keeps zip ^4 (Cargo.toml:198)
exceptions.approvedBy: Astra 2026-10-22 MODIFY (temporary; Windows bundles are raw signed installers, ZIP path signature-verified first; reassess on platform, path or key change), D:/scratch/rk-888/astra-zip-answer.md
